title: Kitewing — Agentic Data Analysis
excerpt: Kitewing is an enterprise-grade data analysis agent. It comes with centrally governed, permissioned connectors to your data sources. It features staging environments, golden prompts and unit tests for accurate answers. It deploys into our cloud or yours.
